description: 【POWERFUL 150W COPPER MOTOR & 35NM TORQUE】:The cordless drilling machine with a robust 150-Watt pure copper motor that delivers a maximum torque of 35 Nm. This drill provides high efficiency and reliable strength for drilling into wood, metal, plastic, and masonry, while operating quieter and cooler than standard brushed alternatives.The compact 1 kg body ensures it's powerful without being bulky or causing user fatigue during extended drilling machine for home use applications. 【2*2000mAh HIGH-CAPACITY BATTERIES & SAFETY PROTECTION】:This powerful drill machine comes with 2Pcs 2000mAh lithium-ion battery for extended runtime and minimal downtime (one charges while you work). The battery features Over-Current, Over-Voltage, and Over-Heat Protection for maximum safety and durability. Great Value Addition: These batteries are compatible with the Dongcheng 12V platform, offering flexibility if you plan to expand your tool collection in the future. 【PRECISION CONTROL: 2-Speed Transmission & 18+1 Clutch】:Easily adapt to any task with this cordless drill featuring 2-Speed Transmission: 0-400 RPM for high-torque screwdriving and 0-1500 RPM for fast drilling. The 18+1 adjustable torque clutch allows you to dial in the exact power setting to prevent stripping screws or over-drilling into delicate materials, giving you total control over every project. 【FLEXIBLE SHAFT & BUILT-IN LED LIGHT】:Tackle jobs in tight, awkward spaces with the included flexible shaft extension. The integrated LED work light on this cordless drilling machine automatically illuminates dark corners, under cabinets, or dimly lit electrical boxes, ensuring accuracy and safety in all working conditions without the hassle of tangled power cords. 【READY-TO-USE 34-PIECE ALL-INCLUSIVE KIT】:Unbox this drilling machine and start working immediately. The set includes everything you need: 1x 12V Cordless Drill Driver, 2x 2000mAh Batteries, 1x Fast Charger, 3.2mm & 4.2mm & 5.2mm Twist Drill Bits, 6mm & 7mm Alloy Triangular Drill Bits, 3*Phillips Bit, 10-Piece Driver Bit Set, 10-Piece Socket Set, Flexible Shaft, and an Expansion Screw Assortment Set. Perfect for furniture assembly, curtain rod installation, and wall mounting in Indian homes.
